(let [s #{\a "a"}] [(count s) (contains? s \a) (contains? s "a") (get s \a) (get s "a") (vec (seq s))])
(let [m '{\a 1 "a" 2} s '#{\a "a"}] [(count m) (get m \a) (vec (seq m)) (count s) (vec (seq s))])
(let [x [{:m {\a 1 "a" 2} :s #{\a "a"}}] m (get (first x) :m) s (get (first x) :s)] [(count m) (get m \a) (vec (seq m)) (count s) (vec (seq s))])

(let [events (atom []) m {\a (do (swap! events conj :first) 11) "a" (do (swap! events conj :second) 22)} output (with-out-str (println (count m)) (println (get m \a)))] [(count m) (get m \a) (vec (seq m)) @events output])
(let [a \a b "a" m {a 1 b 2}] [(count m) (get m a) (get m b) (vec (seq m))])
